newsitem.title: USA: Orthologic to consolidate CPM business.
newsitem.headline: Orthologic to consolidate CPM business.

text.p: OrthoLogic said it plans to consolidate its continuous passive motion business into two facilities, from the six it currently operates.
It said it will complete the consolidation within three to six months.

Under the planned consolidation, all manufacturing of continuous passive motion products -- a form of orthopedic therapy -- will take place in Toronto, Canada, and related administrative and service functions will be handled in Phoenix. The company said it will save an estimated $1.25 million to $1.5 million annually from closing its San Diego facility.
